blocks.text: RIYADH, Saudi Arabia — A strike on a refinery in southern Saudi Arabia’s Jazan killed one person and triggered a temporary shutdown of some operations, state media reported Thursday, hours after the first reports of the attack on the installation. “The attack killed a Nepali worker and injured several others of different nationalities, a ministry official said, adding that the injured were receiving medical treatment,” the Saudi Press Agency said citing the energy ministry, adding that the attack sparked a fire. /dp READ: Saudi skyscraper hit again, coalition slams ‘terrorist attack’...
